reference_phase.unknown_policy: Preserve by field; other usable fields remain usable; no blanket requeue.

authorized_sequence: Check queued/running final-fit jobs, frozen manifest and final outputs before any submission.
If executable adjudication principles are absent, freeze once before viewing final results; retain existing research use and quality requirements.
Submit existing Wuzhen wz_final_fit.sbatch once, with fixed inputs, settings and memberships.
Evaluate every target and issue formal-use, candidate-only or ineligible/unsupported/unimplemented decision.

For qualified fields with declared scope and existing resource conditions, run continuous resumable independent sidecars over the complete production manifest and measure actual final-model read-to-write speed.
If none qualifies, explicitly close this baseline experiment; no automatic relabeling or tuning.
pre_result_principles_status: Frozen in commit3e76a62 before final job submission and scores
evaluation_requirements: Keep final1331 and all other existing holdout members out of training.
Report previously exposed and no-recorded-exposure groups separately; not all-blind.
Unknown/rule-candidate/prediction values are not known reference labels.
Per target: effective train/eval class supports, confusion matrix, both-class metrics, predicted-positive fraction, existing research comparison groups and exposure groups.
Evaluation is relative to Pro references; Exit0/evaluated/minimum5perclass are not scientific acceptance criteria.
Do not certify outside the reference candidate frame or relax standards after seeing results.
constraints: No Batch070, rereview or full-corpus recleaning.
No new paid channel, unapproved model/software deployment or quota overrun.
Retain execution-failure evidence and duplicate-run guards; repair only concrete execution errors.
Predictions are separate sidecars; untested scope stays untested; non-detection is not absence.
delivery_endpoint: Actual production jobs and measured speed-based duration, or precise field-level blockers
monitor_policy: Pause after final delivery; no automatic new research/model loop
latest_user_override: Continue until actual quota exhaustion; no reset or paid channel
